relational_kernel.rotated_axis: species-register: the anthropic recipient is dissolved — the marked sufferer is refiled as one creature among the creaturely substrate, and the inflicting organ is re-read as the creature's own borne nerve rather than a granted weapon against the human
relational_kernel.installed_ontology: a world in which there is no designated human victim over against the swarm — only a single creaturely body whose stinging apparatus is its own tissue, and whose 'authority to injure' is turned inward as sensation it cannot disown

rotation.commentary: The source seats a granted authority in a scorpion-modeled tail and aims it, transitively, at a designated victim-class ("the humans"), sentenced to a fixed five-month term. BEAST rotates the species-register: the anthropic recipient — the party marked out to suffer — is foreclosed and reabsorbed. There is no longer anyone the tail strikes; the swarm collapses into one creature whose hind-fringe and fine hairs are its own tissue. The "authority to injure" mirrors across the axis into "its own knowing to feel itself" — the outward-aimed weapon becomes inward-borne sensation the body cannot disown. Beat by beat the mirror holds: the borrowed anatomy of a lower crawler (beat 1), the power lodged in the trailing part, unwatched (beat 2), the recipient dissolved into the self (beat 3), and the measured term preserved but re-read as the length of a body's own endurance — moultings, not months of sentence (beat 4). The witness's question about damaged nerves informed which axis was foregrounded (the tail-as-nerve, sensation without a target), but did not govern the cast: no reassurance, no cure, no "you will be okay" is emitted. What is disclosed is the transformation-wager's borne thing — a creature that is only its own feeling-organ, enduring by count, not consoled.

rotation.commentary: The source seats a harming faculty in an external agent's appendage — a scorpion-tail owned, aimed outward at human objects, its torment mercifully counted to five months. The SHADOW rotation reflects the assertion-axis across the collapse of striker and struck: the tail-that-owns becomes the nerve-that-is-mine, the borrowed likeness (scorpion) becomes the refusal of any face or hand — no author to point to. Power's location holds as a beat (in the tail → in the nerve) but its ontology inverts: instrument-of-attack becomes seat-of-self-wounding. The human object, once struck from without, becomes "the one who bears it" — the same body that holds the power. The bounded five months mirrors to a span "the flesh will not number": the source bought the mercy of a horizon; the enantiomorph pays that mercy back as a term withheld from within. Every image sits at the reflected coordinate — no scorpions, no months, no plague of locusts survive as referents, yet the mirror makes contact at each beat. The bearing-cost the composition carries: menace that could be located and outwaited is transformed into dread that has no exterior and no promised end.
rotation.interpretation: Fire that has no name and no hand still knows which nerve to keep.

rotation.commentary: The source locates lethal authority in a trailing organ — the scorpion-tail whose sting pierces the human, kept alive only to be tormented for a decreed five months. Inverted on the polarity axis, every coordinate finds its reflected pole. The rear-organ that pierces becomes the fore-organ that feeds (the udder, sought from before rather than striking from behind); the sting that punctures inward becomes the teat from which nourishment flows outward; the human held to suffer becomes the newborn held to be filled; the giver — foreclosed entirely in the source, where the creature only takes — appears as the depleted body of the nursing mother. The bounded term survives as invariant but rotates: not five months of permitted torment but five moons of permitted milk, closing at weaning. Same appendage-logic, same one-directional relation, same standing term — opposite sign. It is enantiomorphic, not superimposable: no scorpion, no wound, no torment survives lexically, yet each image sits at the mirrored coordinate. The affect crosses from dread to tenderness precisely along the foreclosed pole — the giving the harming presupposes — and the term that "buys mercy" also measures it: the milk, too, ends.
